parts.html: The K-45 kitchen is a modern minimalist U-shaped kitchen for a spacious kitchen, a kitchen-living room, or an open-plan space. The fronts are light beige, the tall columns have a light walnut finish, and the work area is dark — a stone countertop and backsplash.

The light cabinets contrast with the dark work surface. The tall units on the left have a wood-grain decor; one of them has an open niche that breaks up the solid wood block and can hold decor or things you want close at hand.
The stone countertop and backsplash are dark with light and warm veining: the work area looks cohesive and pairs well with both the light fronts and the wood.
Layout and peninsula
The layout is U-shaped: cabinetry and work surfaces run along three sides, leaving enough room for storage, built-in appliances, the sink, cooking, and an extra countertop for everyday use.
This is a large kitchen: 8 linear meters of cabinets, with standard overall dimensions of 8 × 2.3 × 0.9 m.
One side turns into a peninsula with a bar area seating two — for breakfast, conversation, and serving. The dark stone countertop continues onto it.
Fronts and carcass
All the K-45 fronts are foil-wrapped: a smooth surface and neat geometry, just as minimalism demands.
The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.
The main fronts are a warm light beige; the tall columns have a wood-grain decor.
Mechanisms and hardware
The upper fronts open on an AVENTOS HF lift-up mechanism, which is part of the standard K-45 configuration.
The hinged doors are mounted on Hettich soft-close hinges.
Drawers run on the Atira Hettich system.
A cargo pull-out is included as well — for bottles, jars, spices, and other small items.
Handles are included. In the visualization, dark profile lines run along the fronts and emphasize the simple geometry.
Where the appliances go
The K-45 uses built-in appliances. In the visualization, they are grouped in the tall wood block: the line of fronts is unbroken, and all the appliances are in one place.
We will position the oven, microwave, refrigerator, cooktop, and sink to suit the size of your room and the way you usually cook.
K-45 kitchen technical specifications
Color: Beige
Style: Minimalist
Layout: U-shaped
Countertop type: Stone
Overall dimensions: 8 × 2.3 × 0.9 m
Length: 8 linear m
Lift-up mechanism: AVENTOS HF
Appliance installation type: Built-in
Cargo pull-out: Yes
Handles: Included
Upper front type: Foil-wrapped
Lower cabinet fronts: Foil-wrapped
Carcass type: Laminated chipboard, 18 mm
Island: Yes, as a peninsula with a breakfast bar
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
Drawer system type: Atira Hettich
Decor: Solid-color in the base specification, with wood and stone accents in the visual concept
Additional features shown in the visualization: tall wood-finish columns, an open niche, dark stone backsplash, dark stone countertop, a breakfast bar for two, and built-in appliances.
We will make the K-45 to fit your kitchen and, if needed, change the shape of the peninsula, the appliance positions, the hardware, and the combination of materials.
